'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Pinto LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Pinto]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
